proposedReviewPolicy.formula: digest(proposedReviewPolicy.basis) using the existing canonical JSON SHA-256 rule; this is a candidate policy, not an admitted policy.
proposedReviewPolicy.retention: The shared global inventory policy changes when a later reviewed implementation appends this disjoint group. Existing five groups keep their byte-identical group objects and exact existing review-policy formulas/hashes; their accepted reviews and public rows remain usable unchanged. The new role group uses this distinct scope-specific policy basis. Unrelated source/list edits cannot change it; changed role dependencies require a new real review and explicit history reconciliation.

structuralAdmission: Dispatch by explicit typed operation and publisher_disclosure_only scope inside the current ledger. Exactly one role target is allowed and it must not overlap any other requested target. Ordinary factual groups keep their current protected-field and immutable-primary-source validation without modification.
Require the same whole baseline inventories and exact complete before record; proposed shape must equal original shape.

Enforce exact target, sourceClass transition and source URL/organization; compare every field except sourceClass/limitations by canonical equality. The excerpt, all numbers, identity, tags, economic/publication dates, retrieval metadata and conflicts stay unchanged.

Validate verified configured xage citation identity, supplier/source joins, HTTPS host, exact requested/final canonical URL, successful archived observation status, exact fetchedAt and content-addressed body bytes/length.

Validate one canonical and one exact matching article wrapper, publisher disclaimer within it, exact Xage byline and GlobeNewswire dateline; bind publisher/provider metadata to this canonical article. A related-story disclosure, bare hostname, logo alone or arbitrary navigation cannot supply scope.

Replay all visible text deterministically, require the recorded text SHA/char count, match each disclosure quote literally and retain all complete relevant text. Structural matching supplies review evidence; it cannot manufacture acceptance.
Do not require the unchanged financial paraphrase to become a newly literal quote. Instead require it to remain exactly unchanged and explicitly exclude its verification from the role operation.
Reject any expired/future source at initial review completion, changed identity/body/time/text/quote, absent provenance, unsupported scope or partial group before accepted cache creation.

independentReview.transport: Reuse existing SubscriptionAgent.call and correction reservation flow, adding a strict publisher-disclosure schema selected only for this typed scope. No new subscription client, API key, billing fallback or publication path.
independentReview.acceptance: All role-specific checks must be pass and every echoed scope/hash exact. The review covers the complete before/after, note and role disclosures. It explicitly does not certify financial numbers or upgrade historical claim support.
independentReview.persistentBudget: Use existing daily documents/calls limits and reservation callback. Reserve document after structural/cap preflight; charge each real model request through SubscriptionAgent.call. Errors, invalid responses, cancellation and timeout retain charges.
independentReview.completionSafety: After review returns, recheck cancellation/deadline and source age using an actual completion clock before immutable accepted writes. Preserve the review attempt when late or rejected.
independentReview.synthetic: Synthetic mechanics fixtures may never create an admissible production accepted index.

archiveAndReplay.typedScopeIdentity: The new review-policy rulesVersion and reviewScope participate in the derived policy hash. Its candidate hash binds the explicit target operation and scope; the evidence-set hash binds publisher-only proof. Reviews, admissions and public rows for this group echo reviewScope publisher_disclosure_only. An ordinary financial review cannot satisfy this identity and a role review cannot satisfy ordinary financial admission.
archiveAndReplay.acceptedIndex: Reuse immutable content-addressed review/admission objects and the existing exact accepted index. Never trust caller acceptance flags. The different group-policy hash prevents cross-scope cache identity even under the same namespace.
archiveAndReplay.replay: Dispatch strict replay by the expected scope from committed requests, then verify the explicit admission scope, baseline, target, full source bytes/text/quote/identity joins and actual accepted subscription review under the derived group policy. Evaluate age at original admittedAt, never renew it during replay.
archiveAndReplay.history: Retain original evidence plus accepted attempt/admission and dated public before/after through the existing history path. Existing five rows and their metadata stay byte-identical. Reuse only unchanged accepted groups; changed relevant dependencies need a new real review and explicit reconciliation.

inventoryPolicy.laterAppendBehavior: Only in a later reviewed implementation, appending the disjoint role group changes the existing global inventory policy, group/target/source-evidence manifest and expected review map in the normal way. It adds one mandatory scoped group; it neither edits the first five groups nor recomputes their review policies by a different formula.
inventoryPolicy.releaseBinding: Use the existing factualCorrections.json bundle, gate seal, detached release receipt and static artifact manifest. Global policy remains the complete inventory binding; each admission policy is the derived group-specific policy with its applicable scope. No second generated file, seal or publication route.
inventoryPolicy.mandatoryGroups: The single enabled projection must contain every requested group, including all five unchanged factual groups and any later appended role group. No partial six-group bundle, bypass, older global inventory, disabled-role exception or earlier-publication exception is admitted.

buildRuntimeAndRelease: Extend the current independent Python correction gate with strict typed operation/scope dispatch. It alone authenticates the real role review, adds the accepted row to the same enabled factualCorrections.json projection and emits the existing exact seal. A static consistency seal remains insufficient.

Node independently derives the complete shared inventory and dispatches the per-group policy formula by exact committed scope. Existing five formulas/hashes remain unchanged; the new role formula is distinct. Reject a forged, missing, extra or stale stamp/map entry and an operation/scope mismatch.

Pure TypeScript receives the existing explicit expected global policy and review map and recognizes the new scoped operation as a separate typed target case in the current projector. Require the exact allowed ID, class transition, complete before/after shape and protected fields. Ordinary replace continues rejecting every sourceClass/organization change.

Use the current ledger-wide duplicate target rejection. A role target cannot collide with a factual target, group or later correction; sequential same-record repair remains held for explicit reconciliation. Preserve raw originals and every existing original-history export.

Extend the existing expected-current-views reconstruction and actual-export assertions for the admitted typed row. The same shared evidenceRecords/evidenceById must feed every consumer. Supplier/event views, the financial excerpt and certified figures must remain identical; a post-projection local edit fails.

Use the current evidence map and corrections history/page/JSON/feed. Show publisher attribution, exact before/after class/limitations and narrow scope, without claiming financial certification or owner approval.

Extend only the current seal/release metadata to bind the full shared group inventory and the new row review scope alongside existing hashes/new group IDs/publication UTC date. Preserve every existing required gate and the 557-task source denominator.

Use the existing UTC first-publication date boundary and rollback/restoration flow. Retain admittedAt separately, refuse late first publication, and preserve previous group rows, dates, reviews and raw history across later collections/releases.

Render the affected Xage drawer/library/history at desktop and phone through the current preview/release workflow. Verify only source class/limitations and dated correction history change. No implementation, request addition or publication is performed by this design artifact.

sharedLedgerTypedScope.allowlist: Exactly operation reclassify_publisher_disclosure, reviewScope publisher_disclosure_only, supplier xage, target evidence:TR-xage-1, exact originalSha256, and INDEPENDENT to OFFICIAL. Only limitations can change alongside class. Reject every other ID/transition/field; do not create a general sourceClass patch path.
sharedLedgerTypedScope.requestShape: A later reviewed implementation may append one disjoint group in the existing groups list. It has reviewScope publisher_disclosure_only and exactly one target whose operation is reclassify_publisher_disclosure. Keep the existing five group objects byte-identical; do not append or edit requests in this design task.
sharedLedgerTypedScope.strictSchemaDispatch: Legacy groups with no reviewScope keep their exact current schema and dated-factual-correction-review-1 hash derivation. Only the exact publisher_disclosure_only literal selects the new strict schema and seven role checks. Unknown scope, mixed factual/role targets, replace with sourceClass changes, or the new operation under ordinary scope fail closed.
sharedLedgerTypedScope.noReclassificationOfFinancialAuthority: OFFICIAL is the proposed presentation class for an issuer-attributed release. Only the publication-role operation is admitted; factual-source policy continues to inspect immutable original evidence and its own independent primary proof. The public display class or this role admission must never authorize financial extraction, certification or a recurring-source binding.

freshness.historicalAdmissionRetention: Only a future actual admission made while the source is fresh can later retain its original evidence age. This design receipt is not such an admission.

nextEvidenceActions.whenExpired: Fetch the exact existing configured Yahoo URL under the naturally renewed persistent reservation path; archive actual response, original URL/final URL/time/body and replay complete visible text and disclosure/attribution. Rebind the candidate and require a real review. Do not renew this old observation.
nextEvidenceActions.ifPublisherDisclosuresAbsentOrAmbiguous: Hold the operation. Inspect the actually returned page for a literal original wire/issuer permalink or follow an archived opaque tracking href only as a bounded provenance probe with redirect/host safety. Record the observed final destination; never infer a tracker destination, slug or direct issuer URL.

availableLiteralProbeUrls.scope: opaque provider tracking link; destination not observed

nextEvidenceActions.financialProofSeparate: Any finance correction needs its own direct issuer/wire/filing provenance and ordinary factual review; this publication-role review supplies none.

requiredCounterexamples: General sourceClass/organization mutations through the factual path remain rejected.
A different evidence ID, supplier, original hash, sourceClass transition or any protected-field change fails every layer.
Proposed excerpt/financial numbers/date/URL/publisher identity changes fail even if a model accepts.
Publisher disclosure in a different article, related-story rail, script-only content, changed URL or missing byline/dateline fails scoped structural binding.
Changed observation/body/fetchedAt/text SHA/quote or an over-30000-character individual/combined text set fails before model/document reservation.
Financial-primary or financial-certification scope cannot reuse a publication-role review; mismatched scope fails archive replay and build/runtime projection.
Forged accepted flags or fabricated reviews without immutable real subscription admission/index fail the independent gate.
Incomplete checks, wrong candidate/evidence/policy/scope, expired completion, timeout and cancellation stay pending with charges retained.

Unrelated source change retains a previously real admitted group and public row at zero further review charges; relevant source or target change requires a new review and cannot overwrite published history.
Direct static source edit, stale stamp, modified actual runtime export, partial public rows, same-ledger duplicate target and first-publication date rollover all fail.
Missing, unknown or mismatched reviewScope, a mixed factual/role group or the new operation under ordinary factual review fails strict schema dispatch.

Adding a later disjoint role group changes the existing global policy/manifest while the first five group objects, group review hashes and any original accepted rows remain byte-identical and incur zero repeat review charges.
A parallel enabled classification file, alternate seal or publication path cannot satisfy the shared ledger gate; all requested groups remain mandatory in the one enabled projection.

remainingChoices.recommendation: Reuse the existing dated correction ledger/projection/gate and add only the narrowly typed one-record publication-role operation, review schema and group-policy branch. Retained publisher self-disclosure supports the role scope without financial proof uplift.
agentOwnedWork: Write the scoped implementation changes and adversarial tests inside the existing backend, policy stamp/build verifier, pure projection, runtime/export assertion and gate/release/history flow.
Preserve each existing five-group object, its exact legacy review formula/hash and mandatory admission rules. No general sourceClass/organization relaxation is permitted.

After a later reviewed implementation, append only the disjoint Xage role group through the existing request ledger and regenerate its complete inventory stamp; no request is appended by this design revision.
After normal allowance renewal, use still-fresh exact proof or perform a genuine new check, obtain an actual independent role review and use the existing full independent gate/publication path.
unresolvedEvidence: No original GlobeNewswire story URL or direct Xage issuer page is proven by these bytes.
The current financial excerpt and the legacy Form D assertion are outside this operation and retain their own support limits.
